title.en: Building and Construction Authority (Registration of Construction Personnel) Regulations 2008

completenessNote: 全文，共 15 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Building and Construction Authority (Registration of Construction Personnel) Regulations 2008 and shall come into operation on 18th December 2008.

heading.en: Classes of registration of construction personnel

text.en:
3. All construction personnel shall be registered according to the following classes:
(a)a construction supervisor;
[S 84/2012 wef 01/04/2012]
(b)a construction foreman;
[S 84/2012 wef 01/04/2012]
(c)a construction tradesman.
[S 84/2012 wef 01/04/2012]

4. A construction tradesman may be registered according to one or more of the classes of work specified in Part I of the Schedule that he carries out, or undertakes to carry out, for or on behalf of another person, for a fixed sum, percentage, or valuable consideration, wages or other reward.
[S 190/2011 wef 15/04/2011]

5. A construction foreman may be registered according to one or more of the classes of work specified in Part II of the Schedule, comprising supervision and co-ordination of construction tradesmen or other workmen undertaking the same class of work for or on behalf of another person, for a fixed sum, percentage, or valuable consideration, wages or other reward.
[S 190/2011 wef 15/04/2011]

5A. A construction supervisor may be registered according to one or more of the classes of works, connected with building works, specified in Part III of the Schedule that he oversees the execution or performance thereof, for or on behalf of another person, for a fixed sum, percentage, or valuable consideration, wages or other reward.
[S 84/2012 wef 01/04/2012]

6.—(1) A person is eligible to be registered as a construction tradesman —
(a)in a class of work specified in paragraph 1 of Division 1 of Part I of the Schedule, if —
(i)he possesses —
(A)any of the qualifications specified in paragraph 1 of Division 1 of Part I of the Schedule, or such other qualifications that, in the opinion of the Authority, are equivalent to any of those qualifications so specified; and
(B)such practical experience that, in the opinion of the Authority, complements those qualifications;
(ii)he completes such course as the Authority may require; and
(iii)he passes such skills assessment as the Authority may conduct; or
(b)in the class of work specified in paragraph 2 of Division 1 of Part I of the Schedule, if —
(i)he possesses —
(A)the qualification specified in paragraph 2 of Division 1 of Part I of the Schedule, or such other qualification that, in the opinion of the Authority, is equivalent to the qualification so specified; and
(B)such practical experience that, in the opinion of the Authority, complements this qualification;
(ii)he completes such course as the Authority may require; and
(iii)he passes such skills assessment as the Authority may conduct.
(2) Paragraph (1)(a)(ii) and (iii), or (1)(b)(ii) and (iii) (as the case may be), does not apply to a person who is eligible to be registered as a construction tradesman in a class of work specified in any paragraph under Division 2 of Part I of the Schedule, if the qualification he possesses is specified in that paragraph.
(3) A person is eligible to renew his registration as a construction tradesman —
(a)in a class of work specified in paragraph 1 of Division 1 of Part I of the Schedule, if —
(i)he possesses —
(A)any of the qualifications specified in paragraph 1 of Division 1 of Part I of the Schedule, or such other qualifications that, in the opinion of the Authority, are equivalent to any of those qualifications so specified; and
(B)such practical experience that, in the opinion of the Authority, complements those qualifications;
(ii)where he does not satisfy the requirements of sub‑paragraph (i), he satisfies the Authority that he has at least 4 years (in aggregate) of practical experience in the relevant class of work;
(iii)he completes such course as the Authority may require; and
(iv)he passes such test as the Authority may conduct; or
(b)in the class of work specified in paragraph 2 of Division 1 of Part I of the Schedule, if —
(i)he possesses —
(A)the qualification specified in paragraph 2 of Division 1 of Part I of the Schedule, or such other qualification that, in the opinion of the Authority, is equivalent to the qualification so specified; and
(B)such practical experience that, in the opinion of the Authority, complements this qualification;
(ii)where he does not satisfy the requirements of sub‑paragraph (i), he satisfies the Authority that he has at least 4 years (in aggregate) of practical experience in the relevant class of work;
(iii)he completes such course as the Authority may require; and
(iv)he passes such test as the Authority may conduct.
(4) A person is eligible to be registered as a construction foreman in a class of work specified in Division 1 of Part II of the Schedule, if —
(a)he possesses —
(i)any of the qualifications specified in Division 1 of Part II of the Schedule, or such other qualifications that, in the opinion of the Authority, are equivalent to any of those qualifications so specified; and
(ii)such practical experience that, in the opinion of the Authority, complements those qualifications;
(b)he completes such course as the Authority may require; and
(c)he passes such test and skills assessment as the Authority may conduct.
(5) Paragraph (4)(b) and (c) does not apply to a person who is eligible to be registered as a construction foreman in a class of work specified in any paragraph under Division 2 of Part II of the Schedule, if the qualification he possesses is specified in that paragraph.
(6) A person is eligible to renew his registration as a construction foreman in a class of work specified in Division 1 of Part II of the Schedule, if —
(a)he possesses —
(i)any of the qualifications specified in Division 1 of Part II of the Schedule, or such other qualifications that, in the opinion of the Authority, are equivalent to any of those qualifications so specified; and
(ii)such practical experience that, in the opinion of the Authority, complements those qualifications;
(b)where he does not satisfy the requirements of sub-paragraph (a), he satisfies the Authority that he has at least 6 years (in aggregate) of practical experience in the relevant class of work;
(c)he completes such course as the Authority may require; and
(d)he passes such test as the Authority may conduct.
(7) A person is eligible to be registered as a construction supervisor in a class of work specified in Part III of the Schedule, if —
(a)he possesses —
(i)any of the qualifications specified in Part III of the Schedule, or such other qualifications that, in the opinion of the Authority, are equivalent to any of those qualifications so specified; and
(ii)such practical experience that, in the opinion of the Authority, complements those qualifications;
(b)he completes such course as the Authority may require; and
(c)he passes such test as the Authority may conduct.
(8) A person is eligible to renew his registration as a construction supervisor in a class of work specified in Part III of the Schedule, if —
(a)he possesses —
(i)any of the qualifications specified in Part III of the Schedule, or such other qualifications that, in the opinion of the Authority, are equivalent to any of those qualifications so specified; and
(ii)such practical experience that, in the opinion of the Authority, complements those qualifications;
(b)where he does not satisfy the requirements of sub-paragraph (a), he satisfies the Authority that he has at least 8 years (in aggregate) of practical experience in the relevant class of work;
(c)he completes such course as the Authority may require; and
(d)he passes such test as the Authority may conduct.
(9) In deciding whether to register a person or renew his registration under these Regulations, the Authority may make such inquiries and investigations as are reasonable and appropriate in the circumstances so as to be satisfied as to —
(a)the good character of the applicant; or
(b)whether the public interest will be served by the registration of the applicant or the renewal of his registration,
including seeking confirmation about the experience of the applicant through further skills assessment and referee checks.
(10) Where a person is registered as a construction foreman in any class of work specified in Division 1 of Part II of the Schedule, he must also be registered as a construction tradesman in the same class of work.
[S 521/2018 wef 01/10/2018]

7. Every registration of a construction tradesman, construction foreman or construction supervisor under these Regulations shall be valid for 24 months, and upon its expiry, the registration may be renewed for the same period.
[S 84/2012 wef 01/04/2012]

8.—(1) Every application to register under these Regulations shall be made by the construction personnel concerned on the Authority’s website at https://www.bca.gov.sg/CoreTrade, or in such manner as the Authority may specify on its website from time to time, and be accompanied by the fee specified in regulation 11.
[S 521/2018 wef 01/10/2018]
(2) Every applicant for registration shall, if so required in writing by an authorised officer —
(a)attend personally before the authorised officer; and
(b)provide clarification to the authorised officer as to such additional information and document as may be required.
(3) Where an applicant for registration fails, without reasonable excuse, to comply with any requirement of the authorised officer under paragraph (2), the Authority may reject the application.
(4) Subject to regulation 6, upon receiving an application to register under these Regulations under paragraph (1), the Authority shall consider the application and may —
(a)register the applicant as a construction tradesman, construction foreman or construction supervisor in one or more classes referred to in regulation 4, 5 or 5A, subject to such conditions as the Authority thinks fit; or
[S 190/2011 wef 15/04/2011]
[S 84/2012 wef 01/04/2012]
(b)refuse the registration.
(5) Where the Authority has registered a person, or renewed the person’s registration, as a construction personnel, it shall issue to that person a certificate of such registration, specifying the class of the person’s registration, if any.

9.—(1) An application to renew the registration of any construction personnel shall be made on the Authority’s website at https://www.bca.gov.sg/CoreTrade, or in such manner as the Authority may specify on its website from time to time, and not later than one month before the date of expiry of the registration, accompanied by the fee specified in regulation 11.
[S 521/2018 wef 01/10/2018]
(2) Subject to paragraph (3), the registration of any construction personnel may be renewed for another 24 months on receipt of an application under paragraph (1).
(3) The Authority may refuse to renew the registration of any construction personnel the application for which is not made more than 14 days before the date of expiry of the registration.
(4) Every applicant for any renewal of registration may be required in writing by an authorised officer —
(a)to attend personally before the authorised officer; and
(b)to provide clarification to the authorised officer as to such additional information and document as may be required.
(5) Where an applicant for any renewal of registration fails, without reasonable excuse, to comply with any requirement of the authorised officer under paragraph (4), the Authority may reject the application.

10.—(1) Subject to paragraph (2), the Authority may by order cancel any registration of a construction tradesman, construction foreman or construction supervisor if —
(a)there is reasonable cause to believe that the registration of the construction tradesman, construction foreman or construction supervisor or the renewal thereof has been obtained by means of any false statement or any statement that is false in a material particular;
(b)the construction tradesman, construction foreman or construction supervisor has knowingly allowed details of his registration to be included in the manpower programme for more than one significant general building work project carried out at the same time;
(c)the Authority becomes aware of a circumstance that would have required or permitted the Authority to refuse registration to the person had the Authority been aware of the circumstance immediately before the registration;
(d)the construction tradesman, construction foreman or construction supervisor is convicted of any offence under regulation 12; or
(e)the public interest or national security of Singapore so requires.
[S 84/2012 wef 01/04/2012]
(2) The Authority shall not exercise its powers under paragraph (1) unless an opportunity of being heard has been given to the construction personnel against whom the Authority intends to exercise its powers.
(3) Where the Authority cancels the registration of any construction personnel under this regulation —
(a)it shall cancel any certificate of registration issued to that construction personnel; and
(b)the construction personnel concerned shall be debarred from applying to register himself again as any construction personnel for a period of 12 months after the effective date of that cancellation.
(4) The person whose registration as a construction tradesman, construction foreman or construction supervisor is cancelled under this regulation shall, within 14 days after being notified of the cancellation of registration, surrender to an authorised officer his certificate of registration, failing which the person shall be guilty of an offence.
[S 84/2012 wef 01/04/2012]
(5) The Authority shall cancel the registration of every deceased construction personnel.
(6) If the Authority has cancelled the registration of a person as a construction foreman in any class under paragraph (1), the registration of that same person as a construction tradesman in that same class shall be deemed to be also cancelled.
(7) In this regulation, “manpower programme” and “significant general building work project” have the same respective meanings as in section 29H of the Building Control Act (Cap. 29).

11.—(1) The application fee to register as a construction personnel in each class or to renew such registration is $15.
[S 521/2018 wef 01/10/2018]
(2) The fee in paragraph (1) shall be non-refundable and shall be payable in advance upon the making of the application to register or to renew, as the case may be.
(3) The Authority may waive, in whole or in part, the payment of any such fee where, in the opinion of the Authority, the waiver is justified by exceptional circumstances or by circumstances beyond the control of the person applying to register or renew registration.

heading.en: False certificates of registration and false applications, etc.

text.en:
12.—(1) If any construction personnel —
(a)makes a false certificate of registration;
(b)knowingly makes use of any certificate of registration that is false;
(c)personates any other person named in any certificate of registration; or
(d)furnishes any document or information or makes any statement in, or in connection with, an application for registration as any construction personnel or for renewal of such registration (whether for that person or for another), knowing that the document, information or statement is false or misleading in a material particular,
he shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $2,000.
(2) A reference in this regulation to a false certificate of registration shall be a reference —
(a)to a document that is not a certificate of registration but purports to be one; or
(b)to a document that is a certificate of registration that has been altered by a person who is not authorised to alter that document, or that purports to have been altered on a date on which, or at a place at which, or otherwise in circumstances in which, it was not in fact made or altered.
(3) A person shall be treated for the purposes of this regulation as making a false certificate of registration if he alters a document so as to make it false in any respect (whether or not it was already a false document before the alteration or is false in some other respect apart from that alteration).

13. Nothing in these Regulations shall affect the operation of any other written law relating to the licensing or regulation of any construction personnel, and the requirements of these Regulations shall be in addition to and not in substitution or derogation of the provisions of those other written laws.

Part IV
1. In this Schedule —
“Advanced Builder Certificate” means any Advanced Builder Certificate issued by the Authority;
“Approved Supervisory Certificate” means any Approved Supervisory Certificate issued by the Authority;
“Builder Certificate” means any Builder Certificate issued by the Authority;
“Certificate of Registration” means the certificate of registration issued under regulation 6(3)(a) of the Workplace Safety and Health (Operation of Cranes) Regulations 2011 (G.N. No. S 515/2011);
“Construction Trade Foreman Certificate” means the Construction Trade Foreman Certificate issued by the Authority;
“Electrical Worker Licence” means the electrical worker licence granted under section 82 of the Electricity Act (Cap. 89A);
“Gas Service Worker Licence” means the gas service worker licence granted under section 12 of the Gas Act (Cap. 116A);
“National Certificate in Construction Supervision” means the National Certificate in Construction Supervision issued by the Authority;
“NBQ” means any National Building Qualification issued by the Building and Construction Authority Academy;
“NITEC” means the National Institute of Technical Education Certificate issued by the Institute of Technical Education, Singapore;
“NTC” means the National Trade Certificate issued by the Vocational and Industrial Training Board or the Institute of Technical Education, Singapore;
“Plumber Licence” means the plumber’s licence granted under section 40J of the Public Utilities Act (Cap. 261);
“SEC” means any Skills Evaluation Certificate (Practical) issued by the Authority;
“SEC(K)” means any Skills Evaluation Certificate (written and practical) issued by the Authority;
“Trade Diploma” means any Trade Diploma issued by the Building and Construction Authority Academy.
[S 521/2018 wef 01/10/2018]
